summary: Eight sequential-then-parallel tasks, one PR against sjawhar/legion on legion/LEGION-6. Daemon: every tmux argv is `tmux -L legion-<project> …` via a TmuxServer {run, socket} threaded through tmux.ts, worker-boot-watchdog.ts and processes.ts; a new secrets.ts writes <state_dir>/secrets (0700) / files (0600); dispatch-token is written by index.ts at startup; per-pane files named by role token are written inside launchShimmedProcess/spawnController before any tmux call and pruned by ProcessManager.persist() whenever no live locator references them (plus once at boot). Panes get only DISPATCH_TOKEN_FILE / LEGION_BOOT_TOKEN_FILE / LEGION_CONTROLLER_SECRET_FILE. Consumers: envoy-client readSecretFile + DISPATCH_TOKEN_FILE precedence (error channel), pi-envoy requiredSecret (throws), daemon CLI resolveControllerSecret (CliError). Smoke: legion_tmux helper, checkpoint 13, down.sh on the private socket, README.
taskOrder: 2 private tmux socket: tmux.ts TmuxServer, watchdog dep, processes.ts wiring, kill-pane `no server running` = gone, codemod of ~375 test sites, real-shutdown-e2e on legion-realshutdown socket

6 pi-envoy requiredSecret in classify.ts, legion.ts boot-token reads, requiredControllerCapability, docs/skills

refinementsFromSpec: Pane secret files are named by role token (legion-<project>-<key>-<role>, legion-<project>-controller) instead of root-<KEY>/worker-<KEY>-<role>/controller — the token is the identity every launch, stop, and state entry already carries; no WorkerLocator schema change.

Removal is derived: ProcessManager.persist() = saveState + prune of every secrets/ entry no live locator (tree, worker claim, controller), the dispatch-token, or an in-flight launch references; boot-time prune in index.ts. Replaces per-site rm at the 14 locator-clearing sites and is safe against a stale generation's stop deleting a newer generation's same-named file.

stopProcess treats kill-pane stderr `no server running` as pane-gone (alongside `can't find pane`): on the private socket no server means no Legion pane; required for the spec's own upgrade story (old default-server panes → retire → resurrect) to not throw StopFailed before the first new-session. Three test fixtures switch from `no server running` to `lost server`.
dispatch-token file is written in index.ts startDaemonLocked (not resolveDaemonEnvironment, which index.test.ts replaces wholesale) — same refuse-to-start semantics.

resolveDispatchConfig reports a bad DISPATCH_TOKEN_FILE via its existing {enabled:false,error} channel (envoy.ts surfaces it at session start) rather than throwing from the extension's top level; it still never falls back. pi-envoy legion.ts/classify.ts and the daemon CLI throw as the spec says.
stripDispatchEnv also strips DISPATCH_TOKEN_FILE from every non-pane child.

upgradeRunbook: stop daemon → `tmux kill-session -t legion-<slug>` on the default server once → start new daemon → attach with `tmux -L legion-<slug> attach -t legion-<slug>`; documented in daemon AGENTS.md (Task 8).
observationsOutOfScope: tmux.panePid runs `list-panes -t %N -F #{pane_pid}`; tmux resolves a pane target to its window for list-panes, so it returns the window's first pane pid — for a split worker pane this can probe a sibling. Pre-existing; checkpoint 13 uses display-message -p -t %N '#{pane_pid}'. Worth its own issue.
